primary.title: Missed filing ITR in previous years? What taxpayers can still do
primary.summary: Taxpayers who missed income tax return deadlines may seek remedies under the income tax act, such as condonation of delay or updated returns. Here's how each provision works and who can file for condonation of delay if they missed filing ITRs in previous years.
